Short title and commencement

SINDH PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION
SINDH
PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(11)/2002, dated
27-4-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor, of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Privatization
Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 16th July, 2001.

Insertion of section 39-A in Sindh Ordinance No. XXV of 2001

SINDH PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION
SINDH
PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(11)/2002, dated
27-4-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor, of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Insertion of section 39-A
in Sindh Ordinance No. XXV of 2001.---In the Sindh Privatization Commission
Ordinance, 2001, after section 39, the following new section shall be
inserted:--
"39-A. Until rules are famed
under section 39, the Commission may provide privatization programme under
section 21, lay down guidelines for performing the valuation of the property
under section 23 and specify procedure for carrying out privatization under
section 24".
